artworks.title: Vulcan
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius after Polidoro da Caravaggio
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body nude statue of a male figure standing in a niche. He is positioned in a frontal stance with a hammer in his right hand and a metallic object in his left. The statue has detailed facial features with a full beard and curly hair, a stern expression, and muscular legs drapped modestly with a cloth. Around the statue is an arch-shaped niche with intricate architectural elements. Two winged figures flank the top of the niche, holding a floral garland. The word "VVLCANVS" is inscribed at the top. The background has elaborate textures, resembling a stone facade, suggesting a classic or Renaissance style.

artworks.title: Sol or Apollo
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius after Polidoro da Caravaggio
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure of a person standing upright in a niche. The person is nude, apart from a cloth draping the lower body. They hold a bow in one hand and lean on an object with the other arm, which resembles a staff or a bow detail. The person has curly hair, defined facial features, and a focused expression. A quiver filled with arrows is slung across the back. Surrounding the figure are pillars, an arch, and two cherubs holding a decorative wreath above the arch. The word "SOL" is inscribed at the top. In the background, there are intricate classical-style architectural elements, including a serpent entwined among other carvings near the figure's feet.

artworks.title: Jupiter
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius after Polidoro da Caravaggio
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a seated figure with strong facial features, a beard, and shoulder-length wavy hair. The figure's lower body is covered with a cloth, revealing a muscular torso. The figure holds a bolt of lightning in his right hand and an eagle is positioned at his feet. The background features an ornate architectural setting with two columns, decorative elements, an inscription reading 'IVPPITER,' and winged figures in relief.

artworks.title: Bacchus
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius after Polidoro da Caravaggio
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a muscular, nude male figure standing in an arched niche holding a cup or goblet close to his face. Two smaller figures are at his side, one holding a bunch of grapes. The figure is crowned with cascades of grape vines and other leaves. Above the arch, two reclining figures flank the central text 'BACCHUS'. The drawing features meticulous line work and shading, creating a three-dimensional effect.

artworks.title: Mercury
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius after Polidoro da Caravaggio
artworks.description: The image shows an individual standing in a classical contrapposto pose with one arm bent and the other holding a staff. The person has a muscular physique and distinctive facial features with short, curly hair. The head is adorned with a flat cap with winged embellishments. A flowing cloth drapes over one shoulder and falls to cover part of the lower body. The individual holds a staff with twin snakes and wings, a caduceus. The person wears winged sandals. The figure is set within an ornate niche with architectural details such as columns and friezes. In the background, there are two winged figures on the arch and additional classical patterns.

artworks.title: Studies for the Façade of Santa Cristina [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts architectural sketches and details of a complex and ornate structure with a classical façade adorned with columns, arches, and statues. Additional sketches and architectural ornaments are included to provide insight into the architectural elements being contemplated. The drawing showcases preliminary design work and captures grandeur and intricacy in architectural planning.

artworks.title: Floor Plan [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a depiction of an architectural floor plan. It is a detailed floor plan of a building with symmetrical design featuring a large central circular area connected by four extending semicircular sections at each corner. The drawing includes precise lines, shaded areas to indicate different elements of the structure, a scale indicator at the bottom, and architectural annotations throughout. The drawing is on slightly aged paper.

artworks.title: The Apotheosis of San Vitale
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and black chalk with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of winged figures and clouds. The artwork shows several winged figures moving through clouds in an upward motion. The central figure holds a palm frond or staff. The composition includes swirling lines and flowing drapery, conveying movement and grandeur within an oval frame. The different postures among the figures, along with the billowing clouds, enhance the energetic nature of the scene.

artworks.title: Landscape with Roger Liberating Angelica
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 30.3 x 44.7 cm (11 15/16 x 17 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The artwork shows a landscape with a reclining figure near a tree, a dragon-like creature, ruins, a fortified structure, a river flowing under an arched bridge, and architectural elements on the horizon. The sky is filled with swirling clouds, and an armored figure rides a lion. The engraving features fine lines and intricate details, with a grayscale color palette creating contrast through light and shadow.

artworks.title: Cart on the Beach at Etretat
artworks.medium: watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a horse-drawn cart moving along a sandy path in a flat, open landscape. Buildings are visible in the distance on the left side, with vertical markers or poles scattered on the right. The brushstrokes are light and feathery, suggesting a watercolor technique. The color palette consists of pale blues and soft whites, creating a cool, tranquil atmosphere that aligns with the expansive sky. Darker splashes of color add texture to the ground, hinting at patches of vegetation or ripples in the sandy surface.

artworks.title: The Waterfall (Wasserfall im Werdenfelsischen)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a waterfall cascading down rocky outcrops in a forested area. Trees and rocks are prominent in the scene, with intricate details captured through textured brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying shades of black and white to convey texture and contrast. Close to us, water gathers in a pool surrounded by stones and sparse vegetation, while in the distance, trees blend with the rocky terrain.

artworks.title: River God with an Eagle
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bearded figure with a bird and a staff with a double-headed eagle atop it in a serene landscape. The figure is resting with a cloth over their lower body, holding the staff. Beside them, a large bird stands alert. The background features hills, clouds, and architectural elements. The line work is delicate yet firm, with a touch of classical influence.

artworks.title: Halberdier and Two Pikemen
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts three full-length figures occupying the center of the composition, positioned in a triangular formation facing the viewer. The central figure stands with his feet apart, holding a large halberd with both hands, and is adorned in detailed armor, complete with a feathered helmet. His facial features reveal a long beard, prominent nose, and sharp eyes. Both figures flanking him sport beards and mustaches, are attired in decorated, pleated doublets, and hold swords at their waists. All three figures are dressed in garments displaying intricate designs and patterns. Various decorative elements frame the scene. The background features additional figures engaged in activities like gardening and strolling within an architectural setting, which includes a series of plants, grapevines, and potted flowers.

artworks.title: Studies for a Servant in "The Last Supper"
artworks.medium: black, red, and yellow chalk heightened with  white chalk on blue tinted paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person's left arm extending downwards over a rounded object in the lap, possibly a basket or bowl. The right leg is also depicted, bent to show the ankle and foot. The person's face and hair are not visible. The person appears to be sitting. Clothing details are minimal, and the background is a simple, textured surface.

artworks.title: River Landscape with a Distant Bridge
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 11.5 x 22.5 cm (4 1/2 x 8 7/8 in.)
support: 18.7 x 27.7 cm (7 3/8 x 10 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. and Mrs. J.H. Steiner
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch drawn from a straight-on perspective, depicting a rustic and serene scene. A simple wooden structure is to the left, with a copse of trees framing the area. Loose, casual brushstrokes create texture and depth, with a high horizon line and monochromatic color palette of grayscale tones. Other rural elements are suggested in the distance.

artworks.title: Karl Ramler
artworks.artist: Johann Friedrich Bause after Anton Graff
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a man named Karl Wilh. Ramler. He is depicted facing slightly to his right with a gentle smile. His features include a high forehead, arched eyebrows, and subtle lines around his eyes. His hair is styled in a powdered wig with curls and a queue. He wears a formal coat with visible buttons and a shirt with a tied cravat. The background features an oval frame with ornamental details, and the nameplate below the portrait is elaborately decorated.

artworks.title: Christian Weisse
artworks.artist: Johann Friedrich Bause after Anton Graff
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, looking slightly to his left. He has a round face, prominent nose, and affable expression. His hair is in an 18th-century style, white, curly, possibly powdered, and pulled back. He wears a formal coat with decorative elements, a ruffled cravat, and is framed by a circular frame with intricate designs and supports. The background is dark, and beneath the frame is the name "Christian Felix Weisse."

artworks.title: Daniel Chodowiecki
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up, in a three-quarter view. The man has a smooth complexion, a subtle smile, white hair, and elegant attire. He is depicted within an oval frame with decorative elements. Below the portrait, text reads, "Daniel Nicol. Chodowiecky," and additional details about the sitter. The artwork has an engraved appearance with detailed lines and shading.

artworks.title: Daniel Chodowiecki
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man, in profile facing right. The man has a prominent nose and high forehead, with mature facial features. His hair is styled back and tied with a bow. He wears an 18th-century-style coat with a high collar and buttons. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is off-white with a texture. Below the portrait is the name "Daniel Chodowiecki" in decorative script.

artworks.title: Dancer with a Tambourine
artworks.medium: black chalk and graphite on light brown paper, laid down, with later framing line in black ink
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a person from head to foot. The person is shown in a dynamic position with one arm extended forward holding a tambourine. Their facial features are detailed, and they have a neutral expression. The hair appears to be styled upwards or covered by a head piece. The clothing is flowing and draped, possibly indicating a long and loose-fitting garment with gathered sleeves at the wrist. The background is plain with no other objects or scenery, emphasizing the figure in the sketch.

artworks.title: Standing Cavalier Wearing a Sword
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of black chalk and graphite
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a person in a side profile, looking to the left. The individual has distinct facial features with a prominent nose and chin, and hair tucked under a tall, cylindrical hat. They wear elaborate historical attire with a large ruffled collar, voluminous sleeves, and a flowing cape. The person also wears breeches, intricately designed socks, and decorative shoes. A sword with an ornate hilt is visible at their side. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Hercules Leaning on His Club [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 28.1 x 16.2 cm (11 1/16 x 6 3/8 in.)
support: 32.4 x 21.4 cm (12 3/4 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length figure of a person standing upright. The person is partially draped in a flowing, textured garment that covers one shoulder and extends down the body. The person's face is shown in a three-quarter view with facial features, including a curly beard and hair. The drawn lines suggest a muscular build. The person holds a staff or stick with one hand, partly covered by the draped cloth. No jewelry or additional objects are apparent. The background is plain without any detailed features, and the texture and tone of the paper are evident, giving the image an aged appearance.

artworks.title: Gothic Vault [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: This drawing depicts an architectural interior with an archway and vaulted ceiling. The rough, sketch-like style shows a section of the vaulted ceiling supported by a column transitioning into a curved arch. The emphasis is on the lines of the vaults and arches, accented with cross-hatching for depth. There are outlines that could represent windows or columns, hinting at further details. The upper part of the drawing includes abstract marks that may suggest figures or additional details. The medium is pen and ink on paper with aged patina.

artworks.title: March
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.4 x 15.4 cm (8 7/16 x 6 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a snowball fight scene with people engaging in the activity. The setting is a snow-covered outdoor environment with trees. Snowballs are being thrown and caught, with various wooden structures nearby. Snow is falling heavily in the background, adding movement to the scene. The individuals in the scene are depicted with expressions and poses indicating joy and active participation in the winter activity.
